title: 5-change release notes
provenance: Squash commits of omnibase_core@dc68ba4c0ce5, omnibase_core@e5e24ea28bd0, omnimarket@80f4e4295eb6, omnimarket@9db3d9a9d258, omnimarket@734696cb8052
prompt:
Write release notes of at most 120 words covering ALL 5 merged changes below. Name each change's pull request number exactly as written (#NNNN). Use only facts stated in the changes; invent no number or identifier.

--- change 1 (repo omnibase_core, pull request #1764) ---
fix(OMN-19515): validate-union-usage is one whole-tree ratchet, not a per-batch cap (#1764)
The hook ran with pass_filenames true and --allow-invalid 160, which the script
applied to each pre-commit xargs batch. pre-commit shuffles files with a fixed
seed and partitions them, so adding any file reshuffles every batch: dev (4229
files) split 104/132/113/91 and passed, omnibase_core#1761 (4233 files) split
77/60/116/188 and failed, although the whole-tree total moved 440 -> 441.

- The hook now runs once over src/ (pass_filenames false). The script excludes
  protocols/ itself via a new

--- change 2 (repo omnibase_core, pull request #965) ---
feat(OMN-10219): Gate 5 — ban **kwargs: object / **kwargs: Any in Protocol method signatures (#965)
* feat(OMN-10211): scaffold substrate_gates package in omnibase_core

Adds the substrate gate framework package used by Tasks 2-9 (individual
gate implementations). Provides BaseGateCheck, GateViolation,
has_allow_annotation, and main_for_gate — the shared AST-check
infrastructure all 8 gates will extend.

- src/omnibase_core/cli/substrate_gates/__init__.py — public re-exports
- src/omnibase_core/cli/substrate_gates/gate_violation.py — GateViolation
  frozen dataclass (one class per file per ONE

--- change 3 (repo omnimarket, pull request #3071) ---
fix(OMN-19813): reject an empty-string agent_id on claude_hook_events / claude_agent_spans (#3071)
Hostile-review follow-up on omnibase_infra#4169. min_length=1 on the three
agent_id models, and migration 0002 (byte-identical to the omnibase_infra
vendored copy) adding a CHECK rejecting agent_id = '' on both tables.
Re-homed from omnimarket#2968 onto a branch named for OMN-19813 so the F-12
branch-identity gate can bind it.

--- change 4 (repo omnimarket, pull request #3629) ---
feat(OMN-16652): Add node_reject_skip_token_compute and pre-commit hooks (#3629)
Added node_reject_skip_token_compute: contract.yaml, metadata.yaml, models, and handler HandlerRejectSkipToken.handle(ModelSkipTokenScanRequest) -> ModelSkipTokenScanResult. It is a pure scan: a text carrying [skip-<letter> (any case) is a violation unless the same text has "# skip-token-allowed: <receipt-id>" on one line. A staged file is in scope by type (.md .yaml .yml .txt, and .onex_state/evidence files ending .err .json .jsonl .log .out); a commit message and a PR body are always in scope.

--- change 5 (repo omnimarket, pull request #3310) ---
fix(OMN-20157): Raise typed error for non-routable BYOK pins (#3310)
Previously, pinning a non-routable BYOK row failed with a misleading
endpoint error. The resolver now raises ByokPinNotPermittedError with
the correct catalogue code. This aligns delegation-time behavior with
existing registration refusal logic. Three new tests verify the fix,
including the GLM general_api key scenario.

Onex-Lane: next4-byok-proof-2a21
